sections.Profile:
The "Rondeevoo" pinball machine, produced by United Manufacturing Co. in June 1948, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a nightlife theme. The playfield features two flippers, eleven passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Nightlife, Original Theme, Music
